title: Import statement
subtitle: Upload a CSV or PDF statement for one account. Nothing is recorded until you review it.
accountAuto: Find it from the account number in the file
mappingBody: Tell the app which column holds what. It is remembered for this account.
checkDiff: After import the balance differs from the statement by {amount}.
import_account_unknown: Could not tell which account this is. Choose the account.
import_needs_ai: PDF statements need AI. Set it up in Settings, or export CSV from your bank.
import_unreadable: The model could not read this statement.
